sv.title: Här praoar prinsessan Estelle, 14, hos morfar
sv.summary: Prinsessan Estelle, 14, har praoat hos morfar. Hon har varit med på möten, fotograferat en historisk tavla och förberett en workshop på Astrid Lindgrens barnsjukhus. Att vara med på kungens möten var ”kul och lärorikt” skriver prinsessan på Instagram.

en.title: Princess Estelle, 14, does work placement with her maternal grandfather
en.summary: Princess Estelle, 14, has done work placement with her maternal grandfather. She has attended meetings, photographed a historical painting and prepared a workshop at the Astrid Lindgren Children's Hospital. Being present at the king's meetings was “fun and educational”, the princess wrote on Instagram.
